# CICS command spec: status

<!-- generated by tests/tools/cics_spec_status.py render; do not edit (test_cics_spec_status.py fails when it is stale) -->

Per command the spec (`gitgalaxy/standards/cics`, design: [cics_command_spec.md](cics_command_spec.md)) has an entry for: the entry's kind, whether the det translator and the stub runtime take it, its X-register entries ([oracle_assumptions.md](oracle_assumptions.md)), its census use and the cics-crucible cases that issue it. The spec, translator and stub are read live; census use and crucible cases are measured by `cics_spec_status.py refresh` into `cics_spec_status.json` (census: 16 corpora at 8dff2ec2e, 2026-10-07; crucible: v0.5.0, 2026-10-07).

Census use is `programs (burned / non-burned)`, counts only. A spec key is the det translator's: `parse_exec` + `command_key`, then the name-only entry `whole_refusal` finds.

**257 entries:** 105 full, 0 engine-only, 152 name-only.
